# Agent-neutral wording (MNT-019): files and lines where product text may still name Claude.
# Format: <path-glob>[ :: <substring>] # reason
# A glob alone exempts the file; a substring exempts that line only. An entry that exempts
# nothing fails test_docs_layout.TestAgentNeutral, so this list cannot rot.

api/crates/kanbanr-cli/src/main.rs :: Claude(ClaudeCmd)  # the same variant's declaration
api/crates/kanbanr-core/src/origin.rs :: Claude,  # the Taker::Claude variant, renamed with the identity type in FTR-097
